title: Fixed Integral Twin-Store Sowing Board
description: One newly authored complete static empty sowing-game board. New full geometry, not a resized old board or a different number of separately copied containers. One editable closed mesh, two opaque constant untextured PBR wood roles assigned to existing faces, metres, native Z up and whole ground-centred origin. One complete prop, zero scenes.
